# Security policy

Do **not** report security vulnerabilities in public issues, pull requests or discussions.

**Report privately by email to michael@voeten.online.** Include what you found, how to reproduce it, the affected version or commit, and any suggested fix. Do not include real credentials, licence keys or other people's personal data.

This is an interim channel while the project is private and in development. A dedicated security address, a response-time policy and GitHub private vulnerability reporting will be set up before the first public release (owner action; see `docs/engineering/SECURITY.md`, "Controls").

What happens after a report is confirmed: a fix is developed in a private branch, released as a patch, and disclosed with credit to the reporter unless anonymity is requested. See `docs/engineering/THREAT-MODEL.md` for the threats we design against.
